purpose: Provide complete Grade 1 learning-depth coverage in one PR while preserving Gate-5 identity/evidence boundaries and existing foundations.
existing_reuse: PR #335 Grade 1 Gate-5 bounded scope cards
atomic_boundary_notes: Numeral representation is not counting mastery.
Ordering is not pairwise comparison mastery.
Equality truth is not unknown-solving mastery.
Addition and subtraction unknown positions require separate evidence.
Reading time and producing time representations require separate evidence.
Shape identification, construction, and composition are not interchangeable.
